query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.cc.list
query.sql:
select pc.id, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, et.lastfirst as originalteacher, pc.schoolstaffdcid, ot.lastfirst as replacingteacher, c.dcid as coursedcid, c.course_number, e.dcid as sectiondcid, s.dcid as studentdcid, s.lastfirst as student
from u_ptc5_cc pc inner join cc d on pc.ccid = d.id inner join sections e on d.sectionid = e.id inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join teachers et on e.teacher = et.id inner join teachers ot on pc.schoolstaffdcid = ot.dcid inner join students s on d.studentid = s.id
where pc.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and (:recordid = '-1' or pc.id = :recordid)
order by s.lastfirst, c.course_name, e.course_number, e.section_number
